caption:
Can AI models finally catch up with real-time data? Databricks thinks so.

Training-serving skew silently kills most ML projects. Databricks Feature Store solves this by providing point-in-time correct feature pipelines.

The Feature Store allows for real-time feature engineering with Spark Structured Streaming and low-latency serving via online stores like DynamoDB.

It ensures reproducibility by binding model versions to specific training sets and feature tables.

The platform also enables automatic feature lookups for inference and supports batch and streaming feature computation.
